supportingSources.label: Gold Wings machine and playfield overview

strategy.overview: Build the playfield multiplier with the three top lanes or the flashing left loop, then shoot the right ramp and lock a ball at the upper lock. On the next plunge, guide the ball through the lower-left gate to light the right orbit; shoot that orbit to start Multiball. The active playfield multiplier applies during Multiball, making the spinner and Loop-de-Loop especially valuable.
strategy.simpleOverview: Build the playfield multiplier, shoot the right ramp, and lock a ball at the upper lock. On the next plunge, send the ball through the lower-left gate to light the right orbit, then shoot the lit orbit for Multiball. Use the spinner and Loop-de-Loop while the multiplier is active.
strategy.summary: Complete the top lanes or shoot the flashing left loop to raise the multiplier, then use the right ramp to lock a ball. Make the lower-left gate on the served ball and shoot the lit right orbit for Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Raise the Multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top lanes or make the flashing left loop.

quickInfo.name: Lock a Ball
quickInfo.summary: Use the right ramp to reach the upper lock.

quickInfo.name: Light Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Send the served ball through the lower-left gate.

steps.text: Complete the three top lanes or shoot the flashing left loop to raise the playfield multiplier.
Shoot the right ramp, then make the upper lock shot; the game serves another ball to the shooter lane.
On the served ball, guide the plunge and upper-playfield feed through the lower-left gate beside the lower-left flipper to light the right orbit.
Shoot the lit right orbit to start Multiball, then use the spinner and Loop-de-Loop while the multiplier is active.

alternatives.title: Build the 1–8 award
alternatives.when: Use this while recovering from a missed lock or orbit start.

steps.text: Complete numbered targets 1 through 8 to light the configured Extra Ball award.
Resume the ramp, lock, gate, and right-orbit sequence with a controlled feed.
Complete the top lanes or shoot the flashing left loop before locking the ball so Multiball begins with a higher playfield multiplier.
During Multiball, rip the spinner and repeat the Loop-de-Loop because both scale strongly with the active multiplier.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, Extra Ball and Special conversions, lock sharing, and whether multiplier progress carries between balls.
Test the right ramp and upper lock, served-ball feed, lower-left gate switch, right-orbit start lamp, three top lanes, left loop, spinner, and Loop-de-Loop.

cautions.issue: Locking a ball does not start Multiball or light its start shot by itself.
cautions.response: Use the next served ball to make the lower-left gate, then shoot the newly lit right orbit.
